lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a semi-regular grid pattern with inter-blob spacing increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spots, creating a lattice-like structure where the spots act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple slender, elongated silhouettes are visible in the ventral region, particularly near the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
